[[File:Weldingtorch.png|thumb|150px|A welding torch.]]
'''Welding torches''' were tools which generated great heat to weld metals together.<ref name="TOR:CtB">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Containing the Beast|Belsavis}}</ref> At the time of the [[Third Galactic War]], [[TJG Industries]] was a producer of welding torches.<ref name="TOR:IB">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Iron Beast|Ruhnuk}}</ref> A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the [[Level 2012 Physical Plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was using one to weld a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] grate onto a service hatch when it was destroyed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
